http-fixture.scope: Each HTTP operation reaches its own route/surface over a controlled HTTP peer; response fixtures are not native controller execution.

action-validation.scope: Every catalog action validates a complete request; checks do not contact a site.

api-catalog.scope: Real GraphQL catalog and shared permission/audit/admission checks; no per-action native effects claim.

ui-wiring.scope: Shared route hooks and reviewed action/recovery tests with controlled Apollo responses.

ui-resource.scope: Resource editor/confirmation tests; not exhaustive rendered execution of every native action.

cli-wiring.scope: All 88 catalog command paths are reachable offline; shared request/recovery tests use controlled server responses.

paired-cli.scope: Compiled CLI against real Astro API, PostgreSQL, Temporal and Kubernetes; selected scenarios, not every operation or physical node.

crd-admission.scope: CRUDL for each of six CRDs against real Kubernetes admission; no native reconciler/garbage collector.

release-deprecation.scope: Real Kubernetes deprecation/content immutability and UID/resource-version guards.

kubeconfig-ownership.scope: Real Secret/CAPI ownership guards for kubeconfig access; this does not establish network access to physical workload nodes.

app-kube-operation.scope: Real Astro database/Kubernetes dry-run and observed MachineImage creation.

resource-admission.scope: Reviewed-source target binding, read ETags and durable mutation admission, including controlled controller fixtures.

native-temporal.scope: Real Astro/native Temporal interaction using test-defined native workflows under pinned entry-point names; no node certificate/etcd effects.

native-reset.scope: Real Temporal reset acknowledgement-loss and phase/history checks against test-defined workflows; no physical etcd rotation.

browser-native.scope: Chromium through real Astro/Temporal/database with native workflow fixtures; retains exact review and receipt recovery.

metric-parser.scope: All pinned gauge/label/credential states projected from controlled exporter text, with exact numeric strings and strict rejection.

metric-api.scope: Real database, TLS listener and controller-identity fixtures for durable collection/history; not live NVKE exporter behavior.

metric-browser.scope: Real browser/API/database/Temporal collection and lost reply recovery; controlled native HTTP/exporter peers.

metric-ui.scope: Historical credential rendering, unknowns and exact numeric strings with fixture props; server paging is tested separately in hooks and connected-browser scenarios.

sites-api.scope: Site/authority CRUD, encryption and org/permission boundaries in the real database.

access-api.scope: Imported access enrollment, ownership/CAPI checks and grant boundaries against real local Kubernetes and controlled controller.

maintenance-api.scope: Maintenance state projection and retained-lock/expiry distinctions from controlled controller/native state.

diagnostics.scope: Typed condition and diagnostic projections with bounded output; not an NKTP installation or native provider health probe.

native-tooling.scope: Pinned native binary generation/validation/inspection/bootstrap dry-run and management install planning through a mutation-rejecting Kubernetes proxy. No host provisioning.

cli-tooling.scope: Compiled local native tooling, private artifacts, interruption/recovery and source-pinned NKTP profiles; native scenarios are opt-in.

tooling-source.scope: Executable allowlist for pinned local bootstrap/utilities/install/check/access; no Astro API/UI installation workflow.

nktp-runtime.scope: Pinned Collector validates all ten full configurations; both protocols exercise all five outbound roles with synthetic input, mTLS/auth, outage recovery, label/redaction assertions.

nktp-kind.scope: Point-in-time isolated Kind installation: actual readiness and authenticated HTTP metrics/logs/traces ingestion. No NVKE controller/hardware installation.

limits.scope: Documented source ownership, readiness, native reset and live qualification limits.

provider-classifier.scope: Pure source-pinned provider registry and credential-health classifier, including exact freshness boundaries and conservative malformed-field handling. No Kubernetes reader, Astro API/UI/CLI observation or native provider execution.

provider-reader.scope: Bounded explicit management-Kubernetes reader with controlled HTTP transport: per-provider partial/unreadable states, metadata-only Secret negotiation without fallback, pagination/version/row/byte limits, raw-stream deadline, revocation checkpoints and safe flags. Not Astro admission or native provider execution.

provider-reader-kube.scope: Real TLS Kubernetes API with synthetic NICo CRDs/manager/identity status: actual metadata-only Secret responses, GET-only reader requests, independent provider state and current-generation health checks. No native provider controller or hardware effects.

provider-api.scope: Durable original-actor collection, encrypted history, revocation/run fences and typed GraphQL with exact numeric/timestamp strings; controlled native Kubernetes responses, not native controller execution.

provider-api-kube.scope: Real Astro PostgreSQL and TLS Kubernetes collection for absent provider CRDs; no native provider controllers or hardware.

provider-ui.scope: Pure historical provider rendering with fixture props: independent manager/check facts, exact numeric and timestamp strings, and hidden retained data while loading or failed. Storybook Chromium checks cover light/dark accessibility and narrow layouts; not deployed native provider execution.

provider-hooks.scope: Controlled Apollo responses for receipt-source binding, malformed frames, caller/capability fencing and server identity search/paging. Route tests separately cover historical reads without a live connection; no real backend/browser or controller effects claimed.

provider-journal.scope: Provider request recovery format 6 binds the reviewed connection/version/site/pin and deadline, persists before admission and strictly verifies receipt provenance. Controlled request callbacks; not native execution.

provider-collection-ui.scope: Controlled Apollo collection, missing receipts, original UUID retry, READ-only receipt recovery after connection removal, administrator loss and stale caller visits. Separate component/route tests review the exact target and maintain the shared journal.

provider-browser.scope: Owned Chromium through real Astro API/PostgreSQL/Temporal: dropped admission reply, one durable request, connection removal, READ-only receipt recovery, administrator-only historical data, server identity paging/search/clear and metadata-only browser storage. Controlled Kubernetes HTTP responses; no native provider controller/hardware effects.

provider-cli.scope: Controlled API peers for durable provider admission, frozen receipt provenance and wait fencing, private recovery records, exact timestamp/count strings and malformed history/identity-page refusal.

provider-cli-paired.scope: Compiled CLI through real Astro API/PostgreSQL/Temporal with controlled Kubernetes HTTP responses: lost reply, one collection, READ-only recovery after connection removal, admin-only history, exact values, server paging/search/cursor binding and no extra native reads. No native provider controller/hardware effects.
